features: 27W Ultra-Fast Charging Support: Power up your devices smarter and faster with 27W fast charging support. Built to deliver steady and consistent performance across all Apple devices with lightning ports.

Perfect 1.2m Cable Length: Crafted at an ideal 1.2 metres (3.9 ft), this Type C to L cable offers comfortable reach; great for work desks, bedsides, and even wall switches positioned a little farther away.
480Mbps Data Transfer: Supports dependable 480Mbps transfer speeds, ensuring your daily file transfers remain smooth and interruption-free.
Nylon Braided Skin: Made with a premium nylon braided exterior that feels sturdy, adds strength, and enhances durability for everyday use.

Tangle-Free & Flexible Build: Designed to stay smooth and easy to handle, the cable bends comfortably without forming knots. It comes with a silicone cable tie that keeps it neat and organised when not in use.
10,000+ Bends Lifespan: Rigorously tested to withstand over 10,000 bends, this Type-C to Lightning cable is engineered to handle daily wear and long-term use.

Spaceship-Grade Aluminium Metal Housing: Armoured with an aluminium metal housing for extended tail protection, offering strong structural support and added durability at stress points, reducing fraying and breakage over time. Built to handle constant plugging.
1-Year Manufacturer’s Warranty: Covered under a 1-year manufacturer’s warranty from boAt, trusted by millions of boAtheads.
description: Experience smarter, faster, and more durable charging with the boAt Type-C to Lightning 27W Fast Charging Cable. Built for Apple users, this cable supports 27W ultra-fast charging, allowing your devices to power up quickly while maintaining steady and consistent performance across all Lightning-enabled devices. The 1.2m length offers comfortable reach whether you’re working at a desk, relaxing by the bedside, or plugging into wall switches positioned a little farther away. It’s designed for everyday convenience without being too long or bulky. For everyday syncing, the cable supports reliable 480Mbps data transfer, making routine tasks like transferring photos, videos, and backups smooth and interruption-free. Crafted with a premium nylon braided exterior, the cable feels sturdy and durable in hand, offering added protection against wear and daily use. The flexible braided design keeps the cable tangle-free and easy to manage, and it also comes with a silicone cable tie, so you can neatly wrap, store, or carry it without any clutter.
